newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Lufthansa Cargo says to increase capacity.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo says to increase capacity.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said on Wednesday it would replace its DC-8 freighter between Cologne and New York operating five times weekly with a Boeing 747 freighter more than doubling its capacity to 100 tonnes.

"We will upgrade our existing DC-8 freighter from our hub Cologne to New York to a 747 freighter with 100 tonnes capacity effective September 17," Lufthansa Cargo northern European spokesman Martin Schlingensiepen told Reuters.
He said the connection was one of the fastest from the region to the U.S.

"That means for our region the fastest connection from all five Nordic gateways by our hub Cologne to the U.S. east coast with departing times between 2115 and 2300 (local times) from Oslo, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Gothenburg and Helsinki and arrival time of 0545 in New York the same night," he said.
A DC-8 has a maximum freight capacity of 47 tonnes.
